title: Make rebuilds fast
summary: Every small change reinstalls all the packages. Reorder the Dockerfile so Docker can reuse its work.

tasks.title: `package.json` is copied and installed before the rest of the code
tasks.hint: Copy only `package.json` first, then `RUN npm install`, and only then copy the rest: `COPY package.json .`, `RUN npm install`, `COPY app.js .`

tasks.title: `fast-box` is built from your new Dockerfile
tasks.hint: Save the Dockerfile, then `docker build -t fast-box .`

tasks.title: After changing `app.js`, `npm install` comes from the cache
tasks.hint: The check changes `app.js` in a copy and builds it. If `npm install` runs again, something that changed is copied before it. Look at the order once more.
